# PNG fixtures

None of this is typed in from memory.

## `minimal-3x2.png` (78 bytes)

A 3x2 8-bit RGB PNG (IHDR, one IDAT, IEND, no ancillary chunks), generated by `make-minimal-png.py` with
Python 3.11.6 `struct` + `zlib` (zlib 1.2.13): `python -I tests/fixtures/png/make-minimal-png.py tests/fixtures/png/minimal-3x2.png`.
CRCs come from `zlib.crc32`, an implementation independent of the code under test. Regenerate, don't hand-edit.
